nodes.name: AI Extract Questions From Image

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [ { role: 'user', parts: [ { text: $json.prompt }, { inline_data: { mime_type: $json.imageMimeType, data: $json.imageBase64 } } ] } ], generationConfig: { temperature: 0, maxOutputTokens: 4000, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}

nodes.notes: Reuses the existing httpHeaderAuth credential named 'Gemini API Key' (header 'x-goog-api-key'). Used ONLY for image-to-text extraction, never for generating/rewriting/improving questions or inventing marks. Model: gemini-3.5-flash-lite. Temperature is 0 to keep transcription as literal as possible. onError is set to 'continueRegularOutput' so a failed Gemini call becomes a clean, distinguishable error in the next node instead of crashing the whole workflow.

parameters.content:
02_AI_QUESTION_PAPER_ENGINE (question extractor / structurer)

The teacher already has the questions - this workflow does NOT generate, rewrite, or invent any question, mark, RBL level, Course Outcome, or curriculum mapping. Triggered via Execute Workflow from 01_EXAM_CONTROLLER with { exam, academic_year, class, section, subject, exam_date, duration, max_marks, manual_questions, has_image } (+ question_image binary when an image was uploaded).

- Manual questions are parsed as plain text (no AI call).
- An uploaded image is sent to Gemini ONLY for literal transcription (extraction), never generation.
- If both are provided, they are merged: manual wording wins on overlap, the image only fills in questions missing from the manual text.
- Everything is validated (no questions found, duplicate numbers/questions, missing/invalid marks, unclear image text) and returned as warnings rather than being guessed or silently fixed.

SETUP: configure the existing 'Gemini API Key' httpHeaderAuth credential on the 'AI Extract Questions From Image' node (model: gemini-3.5-flash-lite). No key is hardcoded.
